capabilities: Play a Doom-like shooter inside Obsidian
Switch between story, linear-path, and endless-arena modes
Fight enemies and bosses with three weapons
Collect shards, secrets, diary pages, and achievements
Optionally sync run statistics to the OBSIGAMA hub
disambiguation: Not a vault-management or note-organization tool; it is a first-person shooter game played inside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer. Uses titles of notes open in tabs for enemy names and gravestones, which can be disabled or excluded by folder. Optional OBSIGAMA sync (off by default) can send run statistics to a Supabase service for profiles and leaderboards. Free and MIT-licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in games, so there is no way to play an arcade shooter without leaving the notes app.

relations.evidence: the game shares run counts, active gameplay time

summary: A Doom-like first-person shooter that runs inside Obsidian, offering story, linear-path, and endless-arena modes.
